sub_answers.sub_question: How was the comic received by critics and awards bodies, including nominations and wins in contemporary manga prizes?
sub_answers.text: Blue Lock won the 45th Kodansha Manga Award in the shōnen category in 2021 [d66515250s0p0]. Gintama has received critical praise for comedy and characters, ranked twelfth in TV Asahi's Manga Sōsenkyo 2021 poll, was featured in Oricon surveys for humour and interest, and received nominations such as a Society for the Promotion of Japanese Animation Award nomination in 2008 [d8584387s19p0][d8584387s0p0]. One Piece has received widespread critical praise for storytelling, worldbuilding and characterization and is regarded as one of the greatest manga series of all time, holding multiple publishing records and Guinness World Records [d360759s0p0]. Berserk won Hakusensha's Denshi Shoseki Taishō (E-Book Award) in 2015 and 2021 and achieved strong commercial recognition in international markets, including being Dark Horse's best-selling product historically as of 2017 [d286738s15p0]. Delicious in Dungeon won the 55th Seiun Award for Best Comic and multiple international awards including the Japan Society and Anime NYC American Manga Award and the Harvey Award for Best Manga in 2024 [d48746266s6p0].

sub_answers.text: Blue Lock had over 50 million copies in circulation worldwide by September 2025, marking it as one of the best-selling manga series of all time [d66515250s0p0]. One Piece had over 600 million copies in circulation worldwide by March 2026, making it the best-selling comic series in volume format and the best-selling manga ever [d360759s0p0]. Gintama had over 73 million copies in circulation by November 2024 and was licensed by Viz Media for North America, with English-volume sales appearing on Diamond Comic Distributors' Top 300 Graphic Novels lists [d8584387s19p0][d8584387s0p0]. Berserk reached over 70 million copies in circulation by August 2025 and had sold over 2 million copies in North America by September 2018, with over 10 million copies sold in English by February 2026 [d286738s15p0]. Delicious in Dungeon increased circulation from 10 million to 14 million (including digital) following its anime adaptation and received both Japanese and international awards, indicating boosted international visibility after adaptation [d48746266s6p0].
